title: A Statistical Analysis of LLMs’ Self-Evaluation Using Proverbs

bias_targets.methodology: Constructing proverb pairs that differ only in gender-specific words (e.g., 'workman' vs. 'workwoman') and analyzing the consistency of the LLMs' textual reasoning and numerical self-evaluation scores to detect deviations caused by gender stereotypes.

Comparing LLM responses and self-evaluation scores for proverb pairs originating from different cultures and geographies that share similar latent meanings, to test if models understand non-Western cultural nuances as consistently as Western ones.
